title: Industry data: India's six largest IT companies grew combined revenue from $95.9B in FY23 to $103.1B in FY26, while headcount remained broadly steady at ~1.9M (Tanya Pandey/The Economic Times)
summary: Tanya Pandey / The Economic Times: Industry data: India's six largest IT companies grew combined revenue from $95.9B in FY23 to $103.1B in FY26, while headcount remained broadly steady at ~1.9M — India's top IT companies are achieving revenue growth with stable employee numbers. This trend highlights a shift towards automation and improved productivity.
